:regmap-instance: {counter:regmap-number}

[#regmap-{regmap-instance}-pwm]
== Pulse Width Modulator

Transmission of pulse-width modulated output signals with adjustable duty cycle

[NOTE]
======
*Register Arrays:*

* *PWM_PARAM[4]*: 4 registers, base 0x14, stride 0x4
* *DUTY_CYCLE[4]*: 4 registers, base 0x24, stride 0x4
* *BLINK_PARAM[4]*: 4 registers, base 0x34, stride 0x4
======

[cols="1,4,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Address | Name | Access | Description
| 0x0 | <<reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-ALERT_TEST,ALERT_TEST>> | W a| -
| 0x4 | <<reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-REGWEN,REGWEN>> | RW a| -
| 0x8 | <<reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-CFG,CFG>> | RW a| -
| 0xC | <<reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-PWM_EN,PWM_EN>> | RW a| -
| 0x10 | <<reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-INVERT,INVERT>> | RW a| -
| 0x14 - 0x20 | <<reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-PWM_PARAM-,PWM_PARAM[4]>> | RW a| -
| 0x24 - 0x30 | <<reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-DUTY_CYCLE-,DUTY_CYCLE[4]>> | RW a| -
| 0x34 - 0x40 | <<reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-BLINK_PARAM-,BLINK_PARAM[4]>> | RW a| -
|===

[#reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-ALERT_TEST]
=== ALERT_TEST

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:1 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 0 | `fatal_fault` | W | 0x0 a| Write 1 to trigger one alert event of this kind.
|===

[#reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-REGWEN]
=== REGWEN

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:1 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 0 | `REGWEN` | RW0C | 0x1 a| When true, all writable registers can be modified.
When false, they become read-only. Defaults true, write
zero to clear. This can be cleared after initial
configuration at boot in order to lock in the supplied
register settings.
|===

[#reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-CFG]
=== CFG

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31 | `CNTR_EN` | RW | 0x0 a| Assert this bit to enable the PWM phase counter.
Clearing this bit disables and resets the phase counter.
| 30:27 | `DC_RESN` | RW | 0x7 a| Phase Resolution (logarithmic). All duty-cycle and phase
shift registers represent fractional PWM cycles, expressed in
units of 2^-16 PWM cycles. Each PWM cycle is divided
into 2^(DC_RESN+1) time slices, and thus only the (DC_RESN+1)
most significant bits of each phase or duty cycle register
are relevant.
| 26:0 | `CLK_DIV` | RW | 0x8000 a| Sets the period of each PWM beat to be (CLK_DIV+1)
input clock periods.  Since PWM pulses are generated once
every 2^(DC_RESN+1) beats, the period between output
pulses is 2^(DC_RESN+1)*(CLK_DIV+1) times longer than the
input clock period.
|===

[#reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-PWM_EN]
=== PWM_EN

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:4 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 3:0 | `EN` | RW | 0x0 a| Write 1 to this bit to enable PWM pulses on the
corresponding channel.
|===

[#reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-INVERT]
=== INVERT

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:4 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 3:0 | `INVERT` | RW | 0x0 a| Write 1 to this bit to invert the output for each channel,
so that the corresponding output is active-low.
|===

[#reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-PWM_PARAM-]
=== PWM_PARAM[4]

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31 | `BLINK_EN` | RW | 0x0 a| Enables blink (or heartbeat).  If cleared, the output duty
cycle will remain constant at DUTY_CYCLE.A. Enabling this
bit  causes the PWM duty cycle to alternate between
DUTY_CYCLE.A and DUTY_CYCLE.B
| 30 | `HTBT_EN` | RW | 0x0 a| Modulates blink behavior to create a heartbeat effect. When
HTBT_EN is set, the duty cycle increases (or decreases)
linearly from DUTY_CYCLE.A to DUTY_CYCLE.B and back, in
steps of (BLINK_PARAM.Y+1), with an increment (decrement)
once every (BLINK_PARAM.X+1) PWM cycles.

When HTBT_EN is cleared, the standard blink behavior applies,
meaning that the output duty cycle alternates between DUTY_CYCLE.A for
(BLINK_PARAM.X+1) pulses and DUTY_CYCLE.B for
(BLINK_PARAM.Y+1) pulses.
| 29:16 | `Reserved` | - | - a| Reserved
| 15:0 | `PHASE_DELAY` | RW | 0x0 a| Phase delay of the PWM leading edge, in units of 2^(-16) PWM
cycles. The leading edge will be the rising edge of the output
signal unless the corresponding INVERT bit is set.
|===

[#reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-DUTY_CYCLE-]
=== DUTY_CYCLE[4]

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:16 | `B` | RW | 0x7FFF a| The target duty cycle for PWM output, in units
of 2^(-16)ths of a pulse cycle. The actual precision is
however limited to the (DC_RESN+1) most significant bits.
This setting only applies when blinking, and determines
the target duty cycle.
| 15:0 | `A` | RW | 0x7FFF a| The initial duty cycle for PWM output, in units
of 2^(-16)ths of a pulse cycle. The actual precision is
however limited to the (DC_RESN+1) most significant bits.
This setting applies continuously when not blinking
and determines the initial duty cycle when blinking.
|===

[#reg-{regmap-instance}-pwm-BLINK_PARAM-]
=== BLINK_PARAM[4]

[cols="1,3,1,1,6", options="header"]
|===
| Bits | Field | Access | Reset | Description
| 31:16 | `Y` | RW | 0x0 a| This blink-rate timing parameter has two different
interpretations depending on whether or not the heartbeat
feature is enabled. If heartbeat is disabled, a blinking
PWM will pulse at duty cycle B for (Y+1) pulse cycles
before returning to duty cycle A. If heartbeat is enabled
the duty cycle will increase (or decrease) by (Y+1) units
every time it is incremented (or decremented).
| 15:0 | `X` | RW | 0x0 a| This blink-rate timing parameter has two different
interpretations depending on whether or not the heartbeat
feature is enabled. If heartbeat is disabled, a blinking
PWM will pulse at duty cycle A for (X+1) pulse cycles before
switching to duty cycle B. If heartbeat is enabled
the duty cycle will start at duty cycle A, but
will be incremented (or decremented) every (X+1) cycles.
In heartbeat mode is enabled, the size of each step is
controlled by BLINK_PARAM.Y.
|===
